words.sense: Harmony, agreement, and peaceful relations among people or groups.
misconceptions: Mistakes peaceful relations for agreement on a proposal.
Assumes agreement on a vote means everyone gets along.

words.sense: Broad agreement or general acceptance of an opinion or decision.
misconceptions: Mistakes peaceful relations for agreement on a proposal.
Assumes agreement on a vote means everyone gets along.

semantic_axes.description: Concord names harmony in relationships; consensus names shared acceptance of a particular view or decision.

edges.boundary_rule: Concord names harmony in relationships; consensus names shared acceptance of a particular view or decision.

misconceptions.M1: Mistakes peaceful relations for agreement on a proposal.
misconceptions.M2: Assumes agreement on a vote means everyone gets along.
misconceptions.M3: Treats shared appearances as evidence of either kind of agreement.

chains.frame: Which word best describes what happened among Aisha’s neighbours?

beats.text: After months of arguments, the neighbours began sharing tools and greeting each other warmly again.
beats.decisive_clue: former hostility replaced by cooperative relations
beats.reason: The first beat supplies the deciding evidence: former hostility replaced by cooperative relations.

beats.text: They still prefer different colours for the hallway walls.
beats.decisive_clue: former hostility replaced by cooperative relations
beats.reason: Disagreement about decoration need not spoil peaceful relations.

chains.feedback_short: Former hostility replaced by cooperative relations is what distinguishes concord here.
chains.feedback_deep: Concord means harmony, agreement, and peaceful relations among people or groups. Consensus means broad agreement or general acceptance of an opinion or decision. Here, former hostility replaced by cooperative relations; disagreement about decoration need not spoil peaceful relations.
chains.contrast_rule: Concord names harmony in relationships; consensus names shared acceptance of a particular view or decision.

hints.attention: Focus on harmony rather than incidental details.
